chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Indeed, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will hold a reckoning for all of His creation except for those who ascribe partners to Allah; for them there will be no reckoning on the Day of Resurrection, and they will be ordered to be taken into the Fire.
ai.seo_question: Who is exempt from the Day of Reckoning according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights a unique eschatological distinction in Shia tradition: while all creation faces general accountability, the polytheist (*mushrik*) is exempt from the detailed reckoning (*hisab*) because their sin is so grave it warrants immediate, direct expulsion to the Fire. This reflects the scholarly view that *shirk* nullifies the merit of other deeds, rendering further calculation unnecessary as they are cast directly into punishment.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-66 According to the same documentation, God’s Prophet (S) said, “

Indeed the Honorable the Exalted God will hold a Reckoning for everyone except for those who ascribe partners for God. For them there will be no Reckoning. He will order that they be taken into the Fire.”
